# pvecli vm snapshot

Manage VM snapshots.

## add

Create a VM snapshot.

```text
pvecli vm snapshot add [VMID] [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |
| `NAME` | Snapshot name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-de`, `--description VALUE` | Snapshot description. |
| `--vmstate` | Include RAM state. |
| `-w`, `--wait` | Wait for operation to complete. |

## remove

Delete a VM snapshot.

```text
pvecli vm snapshot remove [VMID] [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |
| `NAME` | Snapshot name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |

## rollback

Rollback VM to a snapshot.

```text
pvecli vm snapshot rollback [VMID] [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |
| `NAME` | Snapshot name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-w`, `--wait` | Wait for operation to complete. |
| `-rb`, `--reboot` | Reboot VM after rollback. |

## list

List VM snapshots.

```text
pvecli vm snapshot list [VMID] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
